9	/-!
10	# Čech 1-cocycles on a finite localization cover as descent cocycles
11	
12	Let `A` be a commutative ring and `f : ι → A` a finite family.  Fix models for the
13	localizations of `A` away from the single, double and triple products of the `f i`:
14	
15	* `S i` with `IsLocalization.Away (f i) (S i)` — "sections on `D(f i)`";
16	* `T i j` with `IsLocalization.Away (f i * f j) (T i j)` — sections on the overlaps;
17	* `W i j k` with `IsLocalization.Away (f i * (f j * f k)) (W i j k)` — triple overlaps.
18	
19	A **cover cocycle** (`IsLocalization.AwayCover.IsCoverCocycle`) is a family of units
20	`γ i j : (T i j)ˣ` that is `1` on the diagonal and satisfies the Čech 1-cocycle identity
21	on triple overlaps, all maps being the canonical (unique!) `A`-algebra maps between
22	localizations.  This file converts such a family into a descent 1-cocycle
23	`cocycleUnit γ : (B ⊗[A] B)ˣ` for the cover algebra `B := ∀ i, S i`
24	(`Module.IsDescentCocycle`, from `AlgebraicJacobian.Descent.UnitDescent`), via the
25	`A`-algebra identifications `B ⊗[A] B ≃ ∀ p, T p.1 p.2` and
26	`B ⊗[A] (B ⊗[A] B) ≃ ∀ t, W t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2` of `AlgebraicJacobian.Algebra.PiLocalization`.
27	
28	The bridge lemmas (`lmul'_cocycleUnit`, `piTripleEquiv_descentFace*`,
29	`piDoubleEquiv_descentIncl*`) compute the images of the simplicial ring maps of
30	`UnitDescent` through these identifications: they become index-wise canonical restriction
31	maps.  Every one of them is an instance of the pi-ext principle
32	(`AlgHom.ext_of_isLocalization_pi`): both sides are `A`-algebra maps out of a finite
33	product of localizations of `A`, so it suffices to compare them on the coordinate
34	idempotents.
35	
36	Consumers (`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PicAffine`) use:
37	
38	* `isDescentCocycle_cocycleUnit` — the conversion;
39	* `cocycleUnit_mul` — multiplicativity in `γ`;
40	* `exists_units_of_cocycleUnit_eq_descentCoboundary` — a cocycle whose descent unit is a
41	  coboundary is an index-wise coboundary;
42	* `map_cocycleUnit` — compatibility with refinement of covers.
43	-/
44	
45	universe u
46	
47	open TensorProduct
48	
49	namespace IsLocalization.Away
50	
51	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
52	
53	section algHomOfIsUnit
54	
55	variable (S T : Type u) [CommRing S] [CommRing T] [Algebra A S] [Algebra A T]
56	
57	/-- The canonical `A`-algebra map out of an `Away f` localization into any `A`-algebra
58	where `f` becomes invertible.  Any two `A`-algebra maps with this source and target are
59	equal (`IsLocalization.algHom_subsingleton`). -/
60	noncomputable def algHomOfIsUnit (f : A) [IsLocalization.Away f S]
61	    (h : IsUnit (algebraMap A T f)) : S →ₐ[A] T :=
62	  IsLocalization.liftAlgHom (M := Submonoid.powers f) (f := Algebra.ofId A T) <| by
63	    rintro ⟨y, n, rfl⟩
64	    exact (h.pow n).imp fun u hu => by simpa [Algebra.ofId_apply, map_pow] using hu
65	
66	end algHomOfIsUnit
67	
68	end IsLocalization.Away

70	namespace IsLocalization.AwayCover
71	
72	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
73	variable (f : ι → A)
74	variable (S : ι → Type u) [∀ i, CommRing (S i)] [∀ i, Algebra A (S i)]
75	  [∀ i, IsLocalization.Away (f i) (S i)]
76	variable (T : ι → ι → Type u) [∀ i j, CommRing (T i j)] [∀ i j, Algebra A (T i j)]
77	  [∀ i j, IsLocalization.Away (f i * f j) (T i j)]
78	variable (W : ι → ι → ι → Type u) [∀ i j k, CommRing (W i j k)]
79	  [∀ i j k, Algebra A (W i j k)]
80	  [∀ i j k, IsLocalization.Away (f i * (f j * f k)) (W i j k)]

82	/-! ## The canonical restriction maps -/
83	
84	/-- Restriction to the overlap from the left index: `S i →ₐ[A] T i j`. -/
85	noncomputable def inclLeft (i j : ι) : S i →ₐ[A] T i j :=
86	  IsLocalization.Away.algHomOfDvd (f i) (f i * f j) (S i) (T i j) (dvd_mul_right _ _)
87	
88	/-- Restriction to the overlap from the right index: `S j →ₐ[A] T i j`. -/
89	noncomputable def inclRight (i j : ι) : S j →ₐ[A] T i j :=
90	  IsLocalization.Away.algHomOfDvd (f j) (f i * f j) (S j) (T i j) (dvd_mul_left _ _)
91	
92	/-- The diagonal identification `T i i →ₐ[A] S i`. -/
93	noncomputable def diag (i : ι) : T i i →ₐ[A] S i :=
94	  IsLocalization.Away.algHomOfIsUnit (S := T i i) (S i) (f i * f i) <| by
95	    rw [map_mul]
96	    exact (IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit (S := S i) (f i)).mul
97	      (IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit (S := S i) (f i))
98	
99	/-- Restriction from the `(1,2)`-overlap to the triple overlap. -/
100	noncomputable def face₁₂ (i j k : ι) : T i j →ₐ[A] W i j k :=
101	  IsLocalization.Away.algHomOfDvd (f i * f j) (f i * (f j * f k)) (T i j) (W i j k)
102	    ⟨f k, by ring⟩
103	
104	/-- Restriction from the `(1,3)`-overlap to the triple overlap. -/
105	noncomputable def face₁₃ (i j k : ι) : T i k →ₐ[A] W i j k :=
106	  IsLocalization.Away.algHomOfDvd (f i * f k) (f i * (f j * f k)) (T i k) (W i j k)
107	    ⟨f j, by ring⟩
108	
109	/-- Restriction from the `(2,3)`-overlap to the triple overlap. -/
110	noncomputable def face₂₃ (i j k : ι) : T j k →ₐ[A] W i j k :=
111	  IsLocalization.Away.algHomOfDvd (f j * f k) (f i * (f j * f k)) (T j k) (W i j k)
112	    ⟨f i, by ring⟩

114	/-! ## Cover cocycles -/
115	
116	variable {f S T W}
117	
118	/-- A **Čech 1-cocycle of units** on the finite localization cover `f : ι → A`:
119	a family of units on the double overlaps, equal to `1` on the diagonal, satisfying the
120	cocycle identity on the triple overlaps. -/
121	structure IsCoverCocycle (γ : ∀ i j, (T i j)ˣ) : Prop where
122	  diag_eq_one : ∀ i, diag f S T i (γ i i).val = 1
123	  cocycle : ∀ i j k,
124	    face₂₃ f T W i j k (γ j k).val * face₁₂ f T W i j k (γ i j).val
125	      = face₁₃ f T W i j k (γ i k).val
126	
127	variable (f S T W)
128	
129	/-! ## The identification of tensor powers of the cover algebra -/
130	
131	/-- The `A`-algebra identification of `B ⊗[A] B`, `B := ∀ i, S i`, with the product of
132	the double-overlap localizations. -/
133	noncomputable def piDoubleEquiv :
134	    ((∀ i, S i) ⊗[A] ∀ i, S i) ≃ₐ[A] ∀ p : ι × ι, T p.1 p.2 :=
135	  (Algebra.TensorProduct.piPiAlgEquiv A S S).trans
136	    (AlgEquiv.piCongrRight fun p =>
137	      IsLocalization.Away.tensorEquiv' (f p.1) (f p.2) (S p.1) (S p.2) (T p.1 p.2))
138	
139	/-- The `A`-algebra identification of `B ⊗[A] (B ⊗[A] B)` with the product of the
140	triple-overlap localizations. -/
141	noncomputable def piTripleEquiv :
142	    ((∀ i, S i) ⊗[A] ((∀ i, S i) ⊗[A] ∀ i, S i)) ≃ₐ[A] ∀ t : ι × ι × ι, W t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2 :=
143	  (Algebra.TensorProduct.congr AlgEquiv.refl (piDoubleEquiv f S T)).trans <|
144	    (Algebra.TensorProduct.piPiAlgEquiv A S fun p : ι × ι => T p.1 p.2).trans <|
145	      AlgEquiv.piCongrRight fun t =>
146	        IsLocalization.Away.tensorEquiv' (f t.1) (f t.2.1 * f t.2.2) (S t.1)
147	          (T t.2.1 t.2.2) (W t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2)
148	
149	/-- A family of units collected into a unit of the product monoid, with definitionally
150	transparent value and inverse. -/
151	@[simps]
152	def _root_.Pi.unitOf {κ : Type u} (M : κ → Type u) [∀ k, Monoid (M k)]
153	    (β : ∀ k, (M k)ˣ) : (∀ k, M k)ˣ where
154	  val k := (β k).val
155	  inv k := ((β k)⁻¹).val
156	  val_inv := funext fun k => Units.mul_inv _
157	  inv_val := funext fun k => Units.inv_mul _
158	
159	/-- The unit of `∀ p, T p.1 p.2` collecting a family of units on the double overlaps. -/
160	def piUnit (γ : ∀ i j, (T i j)ˣ) : (∀ p : ι × ι, T p.1 p.2)ˣ :=
161	  Pi.unitOf _ fun p => γ p.1 p.2
162	
163	@[simp]
164	lemma piUnit_val (γ : ∀ i j, (T i j)ˣ) (p : ι × ι) :
165	    (piUnit T γ).val p = (γ p.1 p.2).val := rfl
166	
167	/-- The descent unit of a family of units on the double overlaps of a finite
168	localization cover: the corresponding unit of `B ⊗[A] B`. -/
169	noncomputable def cocycleUnit (γ : ∀ i j, (T i j)ˣ) : ((∀ i, S i) ⊗[A] ∀ i, S i)ˣ :=
170	  Units.map ((piDoubleEquiv f S T).symm : (∀ p : ι × ι, T p.1 p.2) ≃ₐ[A] _).toAlgHom.toRingHom.toMonoidHom
171	    (piUnit T γ)
172	
173	lemma cocycleUnit_val (γ : ∀ i j, (T i j)ˣ) :
174	    (cocycleUnit f S T γ).val = (piDoubleEquiv f S T).symm (piUnit T γ).val := rfl
175	
176	@[simp]
177	lemma piDoubleEquiv_cocycleUnit_val (γ : ∀ i j, (T i j)ˣ) :
178	    piDoubleEquiv f S T (cocycleUnit f S T γ).val = fun p : ι × ι => (γ p.1 p.2).val := by
179	  rw [cocycleUnit_val, AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
180	  rfl
181	
182	/-- Multiplicativity of the descent unit in the cocycle. -/
183	lemma cocycleUnit_mul (γ γ' : ∀ i j, (T i j)ˣ) :
184	    cocycleUnit f S T (fun i j => γ i j * γ' i j)
185	      = cocycleUnit f S T γ * cocycleUnit f S T γ' := by
186	  apply Units.ext
187	  simp only [cocycleUnit_val, Units.val_mul, ← map_mul]
188	  rfl

190	/-! ## Transport of the simplicial maps through the identifications
191	
192	Each lemma below is proved by the pi-ext principle `AlgHom.ext_of_isLocalization_pi`:
193	both sides, as `A`-algebra maps out of a finite product of localizations of `A`, agree
194	on the coordinate idempotents (a finite computation via
195	`Algebra.TensorProduct.piPiAlgEquiv_tmul` and `Pi.single`-arithmetic, using that all
196	component maps between localizations are canonical), hence are equal.  The forward images
197	of the idempotents are computed from `piDoubleEquiv (Pi.single i 1 ⊗ₜ Pi.single j 1) =
198	Pi.single (i,j) 1` and its triple analogue, plus `1 = ∑ i, Pi.single i 1`. -/
199	
200	/-- Multiplication `B ⊗[A] B → B` becomes the diagonal restriction. -/
201	lemma lmul'_piDoubleEquiv_symm (w : ∀ p : ι × ι, T p.1 p.2) :
202	    Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul' A (S := ∀ i, S i) ((piDoubleEquiv f S T).symm w)
203	      = fun i => diag f S T i (w (i, i)) := by
204	  sorry
205	
206	/-- The face `descentFace₂₃` becomes `w ↦ (t ↦ w(t₂, t₃))` restricted. -/
207	lemma piTripleEquiv_descentFace₂₃ (w : ∀ p : ι × ι, T p.1 p.2) :
208	    piTripleEquiv f S T W (Module.descentFace₂₃ A (∀ i, S i) ((piDoubleEquiv f S T).symm w))
209	      = fun t : ι × ι × ι => face₂₃ f T W t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2 (w (t.2.1, t.2.2)) := by
210	  sorry
211	
212	/-- The face `descentFace₁₂` becomes `w ↦ (t ↦ w(t₁, t₂))` restricted. -/
213	lemma piTripleEquiv_descentFace₁₂ (w : ∀ p : ι × ι, T p.1 p.2) :
214	    piTripleEquiv f S T W (Module.descentFace₁₂ A (∀ i, S i) ((piDoubleEquiv f S T).symm w))
215	      = fun t : ι × ι × ι => face₁₂ f T W t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2 (w (t.1, t.2.1)) := by
216	  sorry
217	
218	/-- The face `descentFace₁₃` becomes `w ↦ (t ↦ w(t₁, t₃))` restricted. -/
219	lemma piTripleEquiv_descentFace₁₃ (w : ∀ p : ι × ι, T p.1 p.2) :
220	    piTripleEquiv f S T W (Module.descentFace₁₃ A (∀ i, S i) ((piDoubleEquiv f S T).symm w))
221	      = fun t : ι × ι × ι => face₁₃ f T W t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2 (w (t.1, t.2.2)) := by
222	  sorry
223	
224	/-- The inclusion `descentIncl₁ : B → B ⊗[A] B` becomes the left overlap restriction. -/
225	lemma piDoubleEquiv_descentIncl₁ (s : ∀ i, S i) :
226	    piDoubleEquiv f S T (Module.descentIncl₁ A (∀ i, S i) s)
227	      = fun p : ι × ι => inclLeft f S T p.1 p.2 (s p.1) := by
228	  sorry
229	
230	/-- The inclusion `descentIncl₂ : B → B ⊗[A] B` becomes the right overlap restriction. -/
231	lemma piDoubleEquiv_descentIncl₂ (s : ∀ i, S i) :
232	    piDoubleEquiv f S T (Module.descentIncl₂ A (∀ i, S i) s)
233	      = fun p : ι × ι => inclRight f S T p.1 p.2 (s p.2) := by
234	  sorry

236	/-! ## The main conversion -/
237	
238	/-- **A Čech 1-cocycle of units on a finite localization cover is a descent
239	1-cocycle.** -/
240	theorem isDescentCocycle_cocycleUnit {γ : ∀ i j, (T i j)ˣ} (hγ : IsCoverCocycle (f := f) (S := S) (W := W) γ) :
241	    Module.IsDescentCocycle (cocycleUnit f S T γ) where
242	  lmul'_eq_one := by
243	    rw [cocycleUnit_val, lmul'_piDoubleEquiv_symm]
244	    funext i
245	    exact hγ.diag_eq_one i
246	  cocycle := by
247	    apply (piTripleEquiv f S T W).injective
248	    have hu : (cocycleUnit f S T γ).val = (piDoubleEquiv f S T).symm (piUnit T γ).val := rfl
249	    rw [map_mul, hu, piTripleEquiv_descentFace₂₃, piTripleEquiv_descentFace₁₂,
250	      piTripleEquiv_descentFace₁₃]
251	    funext t
252	    exact hγ.cocycle t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2
253	
254	/-- A descent unit that is a coboundary is an index-wise coboundary: if
255	`cocycleUnit γ = descentCoboundary β` for a unit `β` of the cover algebra, then each
256	`γ i j` is the quotient of the restrictions of the components of `β`. -/
257	theorem exists_units_of_cocycleUnit_eq_descentCoboundary {γ : ∀ i j, (T i j)ˣ}
258	    {β : (∀ i, S i)ˣ} (h : cocycleUnit f S T γ = Module.descentCoboundary A (∀ i, S i) β) :
259	    ∀ i j, (γ i j).val
260	      = inclRight f S T i j (β.val j)
261	        * inclLeft f S T i j ((β⁻¹).val i) := by
262	  -- Apply `piDoubleEquiv` to the value equation; the left side is `γ` index-wise
263	  -- (`piDoubleEquiv_cocycleUnit_val`), the right side is computed by
264	  -- `Module.descentCoboundary_val`, `map_mul`, `piDoubleEquiv_descentIncl₂`,
265	  -- `piDoubleEquiv_descentIncl₁` (with `s := β.val` resp. `(β⁻¹).val`).
266	  sorry
267	
268	/-- Twisting a cover cocycle by an index-wise coboundary multiplies the descent unit by
269	a descent coboundary. -/
270	theorem cocycleUnit_eq_descentCoboundary_mul {γ γ' : ∀ i j, (T i j)ˣ} (β : ∀ i, (S i)ˣ)
271	    (hrel : ∀ i j, (γ' i j).val
272	      = inclLeft f S T i j (β i).val
273	          * ((γ i j).val * inclRight f S T i j ((β j)⁻¹).val)) :
274	    cocycleUnit f S T γ'
275	      = Module.descentCoboundary A (∀ i, S i) (Pi.unitOf S β)⁻¹
276	          * cocycleUnit f S T γ := by
277	  -- `Units.ext`, then apply the injective `piDoubleEquiv` to both values; the left side
278	  -- is `γ'` index-wise (`piDoubleEquiv_cocycleUnit_val`), the right side is computed by
279	  -- `Module.descentCoboundary_val` (for the unit `(Pi.unitOf S β)⁻¹`, whose value is
280	  -- `(1 ⊗ₜ (β⁻¹-components)) * ((β-components) ⊗ₜ 1)`), `map_mul`,
281	  -- `piDoubleEquiv_descentIncl₁`, `piDoubleEquiv_descentIncl₂` and `hrel`.
282	  sorry
283	
284	section picClass
285	
286	variable [Module.FaithfullyFlat A (∀ i, S i)]
287	
288	/-- **Coboundary invariance of the Picard class**: two cover cocycles differing by an
289	index-wise coboundary have the same Picard class. -/
290	theorem picClass_eq_of_coboundary {γ γ' : ∀ i j, (T i j)ˣ}
291	    (hγ : IsCoverCocycle (f := f) (S := S) (W := W) γ)
292	    (hγ' : IsCoverCocycle (f := f) (S := S) (W := W) γ')
293	    (β : ∀ i, (S i)ˣ)
294	    (hrel : ∀ i j, (γ' i j).val
295	      = inclLeft f S T i j (β i).val
296	          * ((γ i j).val * inclRight f S T i j ((β j)⁻¹).val)) :
297	    (isDescentCocycle_cocycleUnit f S T W hγ').picClass
298	      = (isDescentCocycle_cocycleUnit f S T W hγ).picClass :=
299	  (Module.IsDescentCocycle.picClass_congr _ _
300	      (cocycleUnit_eq_descentCoboundary_mul f S T β hrel)).trans
301	    (Module.IsDescentCocycle.picClass_descentCoboundary_mul _
302	      (isDescentCocycle_cocycleUnit f S T W hγ))
303	
304	end picClass

306	/-! ## Refinement of covers -/
307	
308	section refine
309	
310	variable {ι' : Type u} [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι']
311	variable (f' : ι' → A)
312	variable (S' : ι' → Type u) [∀ i, CommRing (S' i)] [∀ i, Algebra A (S' i)]
313	  [∀ i, IsLocalization.Away (f' i) (S' i)]
314	variable (T' : ι' → ι' → Type u) [∀ i j, CommRing (T' i j)] [∀ i j, Algebra A (T' i j)]
315	  [∀ i j, IsLocalization.Away (f' i * f' j) (T' i j)]
316	variable (τ : ι' → ι) (hτ : ∀ i', IsUnit (algebraMap A (S' i') (f (τ i'))))
317	
318	/-- The refinement map between cover algebras along an index map `τ` making each
319	`f (τ i')` invertible in `S' i'`. -/
320	noncomputable def refineAlgHom : (∀ i, S i) →ₐ[A] ∀ i', S' i' :=
321	  Pi.algHom _ _ fun i' =>
322	    (IsLocalization.Away.algHomOfIsUnit (S := S (τ i')) (S' i') (f (τ i')) (hτ i')).comp
323	      (Pi.evalAlgHom _ _ (τ i'))
324	
325	variable (hτT : ∀ i' j', IsUnit (algebraMap A (T' i' j') (f (τ i') * f (τ j'))))
326	
327	/-- The refinement map on double overlaps. -/
328	noncomputable def refineOverlapAlgHom (i' j' : ι') : T (τ i') (τ j') →ₐ[A] T' i' j' :=
329	  IsLocalization.Away.algHomOfIsUnit (S := T (τ i') (τ j')) (T' i' j')
330	    (f (τ i') * f (τ j')) (hτT i' j')
331	
332	/-- Base change of the descent unit along a refinement of covers: the descent unit of
333	the restricted cocycle. -/
334	theorem map_cocycleUnit (γ : ∀ i j, (T i j)ˣ) :
335	    Units.map (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (refineAlgHom f S S' τ hτ)
336	        (refineAlgHom f S S' τ hτ)).toRingHom.toMonoidHom (cocycleUnit f S T γ)
337	      = cocycleUnit f' S' T' (fun i' j' =>
338	          Units.map (refineOverlapAlgHom f T T' τ hτT i' j').toRingHom.toMonoidHom
339	            (γ (τ i') (τ j'))) := by
340	  -- Apply `piDoubleEquiv f' S' T'` to both sides.  The composite
341	  -- `piDoubleEquiv' ∘ (map h h) ∘ (piDoubleEquiv).symm` is index-wise
342	  -- `refineOverlapAlgHom` by the pi-ext principle (evaluate on the idempotents
343	  -- `Pi.single (i,j) 1`, whose preimages are `Pi.single i 1 ⊗ₜ Pi.single j 1`).
344	  sorry
345	
346	variable (W' : ι' → ι' → ι' → Type u) [∀ i j k, CommRing (W' i j k)]
347	  [∀ i j k, Algebra A (W' i j k)]
348	  [∀ i j k, IsLocalization.Away (f' i * (f' j * f' k)) (W' i j k)]
349	
350	include hτ in
351	/-- **Refinement invariance of the Picard class**: restricting a cover cocycle along a
352	refinement of finite localization covers does not change the Picard class of the
353	descended module. -/
354	theorem picClass_map_refine [Module.FaithfullyFlat A (∀ i, S i)]
355	    [Module.FaithfullyFlat A (∀ i', S' i')]
356	    {γ : ∀ i j, (T i j)ˣ} {γ' : ∀ i' j', (T' i' j')ˣ}
357	    (hγ : IsCoverCocycle (f := f) (S := S) (W := W) γ)
358	    (hγ' : IsCoverCocycle (f := f') (S := S') (W := W') γ')
359	    (hrel : ∀ i' j', γ' i' j'
360	      = Units.map (refineOverlapAlgHom f T T' τ hτT i' j').toRingHom.toMonoidHom

13	/-!
14	# Finite products of localizations of a commutative ring
15	
16	For a commutative ring `A` and a finite covering family of basic opens — elements
17	`f i : A` with `Ideal.span (Set.range f) = ⊤` — the product `∀ i, S i` of localizations
18	`S i := A[1/f i]` is the algebraic incarnation of a finite affine cover of `Spec A`.  This
19	file provides the toolkit used by the Čech–Picard dictionary
20	(`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PicAffine`) to run faithfully flat descent along such covers:
21	
22	* `AlgHom.ext_of_isLocalization_pi` — **the pi-ext lemma**: two `A`-algebra maps out of a
23	  finite product of localizations of `A` agreeing on the coordinate idempotents
24	  `Pi.single i 1` are equal.  This makes every diagram of algebra maps out of such
25	  products commute by pure bookkeeping, replacing all naturality arguments downstream.
26	* `Module.FaithfullyFlat.pi_of_span_eq_top` — a finite product of `Away (f i)`
27	  localizations along a covering family (`span (range f) = ⊤`) is faithfully flat.
28	* `Algebra.TensorProduct.piRightAlgEquiv`, `piLeftAlgEquiv`, `piPiAlgEquiv` — tensor
29	  products distribute over finite products of algebras, as `A`-algebra equivalences, with
30	  pure-tensor `simp` formulas.
31	* `IsLocalization.Away.algHomOfDvd` — the canonical map `A[1/f] →ₐ[A] A[1/g]` for `f ∣ g`
32	  (any two such maps are equal: `IsLocalization.algHom_subsingleton`).
33	* `IsLocalization.Away.tensor`, `IsLocalization.Away.tensorEquiv` — the tensor product of
34	  `Away f` and `Away g` localizations is an `Away (f * g)` localization, hence canonically
35	  isomorphic to any other model of it.
36	
37	Everything is elementary commutative algebra; the file is deliberately scheme-free and
38	shaped for mathlib.
39	-/

47	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] {ι : Type v} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]

51	/-- **The pi-ext lemma.**  Two `A`-algebra maps out of a finite product of localizations
52	of `A` that agree on the coordinate idempotents `Pi.single i 1` are equal.
53	
54	Proof sketch: fix `i` and let `ε := φ (Pi.single i 1)`, an idempotent with the same value
55	for `ψ`.  The map `y ↦ φ (Pi.single i y)`, corestricted to the quotient
56	`C ⧸ Ideal.span {1 - ε}`, is a *unital* `A`-algebra map out of the localization `S i`
57	(unitality is `φ (single i 1) = ε ↦ 1`), hence agrees with the one for `ψ` by
58	`IsLocalization.ringHom_ext`.  Therefore `φ (single i y) - ψ (single i y) ∈ span {1 - ε}`;
59	multiplying by `ε` and using `φ (single i y) * ε = φ (single i y)` (from
60	`single i y * single i 1 = single i y`) gives `φ (single i y) = ψ (single i y)`.  Conclude
61	by `x = ∑ i, Pi.single i (x i)` (`Finset.univ_sum_single`). -/
62	theorem AlgHom.ext_of_isLocalization_pi (M : ι → Submonoid A)
63	    [∀ i, IsLocalization (M i) (S i)] {φ ψ : (∀ i, S i) →ₐ[A] C}
64	    (h : ∀ i, φ (Pi.single i 1) = ψ (Pi.single i 1)) : φ = ψ := by
65	  have key : ∀ (i : ι) (y : S i), φ (Pi.single i y) = ψ (Pi.single i y) := by
66	    intro i y
67	    set ε : C := φ (Pi.single i 1) with hε
68	    have hψε : ψ (Pi.single i 1) = ε := (h i).symm
69	    have hidem : ε * ε = ε := by
70	      rw [hε, ← map_mul, ← Pi.single_mul, one_mul]
71	    -- the class of `ε` in `C ⧸ (1 - ε)` is `1`
72	    have hmkε : Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {1 - ε}) ε = 1 := by
73	      rw [← map_one (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {1 - ε})), Ideal.Quotient.eq]
74	      simpa using (Ideal.span {1 - ε}).neg_mem (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton _))
75	    -- `y ↦ mk (φ (Pi.single i y))` is a *unital* ring hom out of the localization `S i`
76	    let Φ : S i →+* C ⧸ Ideal.span {1 - ε} :=
77	      { toFun := fun z => Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {1 - ε}) (φ (Pi.single i z))
78	        map_one' := by rw [← hε]; exact hmkε
79	        map_mul' := fun z w => by
80	          rw [← map_mul (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {1 - ε})), ← map_mul φ, ← Pi.single_mul]
81	        map_zero' := by simp
82	        map_add' := fun z w => by
83	          rw [← map_add (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {1 - ε})), ← map_add φ, ← Pi.single_add] }
84	    let Ψ : S i →+* C ⧸ Ideal.span {1 - ε} :=
85	      { toFun := fun z => Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {1 - ε}) (ψ (Pi.single i z))
86	        map_one' := by rw [hψε]; exact hmkε
87	        map_mul' := fun z w => by
88	          rw [← map_mul (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {1 - ε})), ← map_mul ψ, ← Pi.single_mul]
89	        map_zero' := by simp
90	        map_add' := fun z w => by
91	          rw [← map_add (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {1 - ε})), ← map_add ψ, ← Pi.single_add] }
92	    -- they agree on `A`, hence on all of the localization `S i`
93	    have hcomp : Φ.comp (algebraMap A (S i)) = Ψ.comp (algebraMap A (S i)) := by
94	      ext a
95	      change Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {1 - ε}) (φ (Pi.single i (algebraMap A (S i) a)))
96	        = Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {1 - ε}) (ψ (Pi.single i (algebraMap A (S i) a)))
97	      have hsa : (Pi.single i (algebraMap A (S i) a) : ∀ j, S j)
98	          = algebraMap A (∀ j, S j) a * Pi.single i 1 := by
99	        funext j
100	        by_cases hj : j = i
101	        · subst hj; simp
102	        · simp [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hj]
103	      rw [hsa, map_mul φ, map_mul ψ, AlgHom.commutes, AlgHom.commutes, ← hε, hψε]
104	    have hΦΨ : Φ = Ψ := IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (M := M i) hcomp
105	    have hmem : φ (Pi.single i y) - ψ (Pi.single i y) ∈ Ideal.span {1 - ε} :=
106	      Ideal.Quotient.eq.mp (DFunLike.congr_fun hΦΨ y)
107	    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hmem
108	    -- multiply the membership witness by `ε` and use `φ (single i y) * ε = φ (single i y)`
109	    have hφy : φ (Pi.single i y) * ε = φ (Pi.single i y) := by
110	      rw [hε, ← map_mul, ← Pi.single_mul, mul_one]
111	    have hψy : ψ (Pi.single i y) * ε = ψ (Pi.single i y) := by
112	      rw [← hψε, ← map_mul, ← Pi.single_mul, mul_one]
113	    have hzero : (φ (Pi.single i y) - ψ (Pi.single i y)) * ε = 0 := by
114	      rw [← hc, mul_assoc, sub_mul, one_mul, hidem, sub_self, mul_zero]
115	    rw [sub_mul, hφy, hψy] at hzero
116	    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hzero
117	  refine AlgHom.ext fun x => ?_
118	  calc φ x = φ (∑ i, Pi.single i (x i)) := by rw [Finset.univ_sum_single]
119	    _ = ∑ i, φ (Pi.single i (x i)) := map_sum φ _ Finset.univ
120	    _ = ∑ i, ψ (Pi.single i (x i)) := Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => key i (x i)
121	    _ = ψ (∑ i, Pi.single i (x i)) := (map_sum ψ _ Finset.univ).symm
122	    _ = ψ x := by rw [Finset.univ_sum_single]
123	
124	end PiExt

128	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] {ι : Type v} [Fintype ι]

131	/-- A finite product of flat modules is flat. -/
132	theorem Module.Flat.pi_of_finite [∀ i, Module.Flat A (S i)] :
133	    Module.Flat A (∀ i, S i) :=
134	  -- transport `Module.Flat.dfinsupp` along `DFinsupp.linearEquivFunOnFintype`
135	  letI := Classical.decEq ι
136	  Module.Flat.of_linearEquiv (DFinsupp.linearEquivFunOnFintype (R := A) (M := S)).symm
137	
138	/-- **A finite product of localizations along a covering family is faithfully flat**:
139	if `Ideal.span (Set.range f) = ⊤`, then `∀ i, A[1/f i]` is a faithfully flat `A`-algebra.
140	
141	Proof sketch: flatness is `IsLocalization.flat` plus `Module.Flat.pi_of_finite`.  For
142	faithfulness use `Module.FaithfullyFlat.iff_flat_and_proper_ideal`: a proper ideal `I`
143	lies in a maximal `m`, and since `span (range f) = ⊤` some `f i ∉ m`.  If
144	`I • (⊤ : Submodule A (∀ i, S i)) = ⊤` then, applying the (surjective) coordinate
145	projection and `Submodule.map_smul''`, also `I • (⊤ : Submodule A (S i)) = ⊤`, hence
146	`m • ⊤ = ⊤`.  Map along the ring map `χ : S i →+* A ⧸ m` obtained from
147	`IsLocalization.Away.lift` (the class of `f i` in the field `A ⧸ m` is nonzero, hence
148	invertible): the equation `1 = ∑ aₖ • sₖ` with `aₖ ∈ m` maps to `1 = 0`, a
149	contradiction. -/
150	theorem Module.FaithfullyFlat.pi_of_span_eq_top (f : ι → A)
151	    [∀ i, IsLocalization.Away (f i) (S i)] (hspan : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = ⊤) :
152	    Module.FaithfullyFlat A (∀ i, S i) := by
153	  haveI : ∀ i, Module.Flat A (S i) := fun i =>
154	    IsLocalization.flat (S i) (Submonoid.powers (f i))
155	  rw [Module.FaithfullyFlat.iff_flat_and_proper_ideal]
156	  refine ⟨Module.Flat.pi_of_finite, fun I hI hIT => ?_⟩
157	  obtain ⟨m, hmax, hIm⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_maximal I hI
158	  -- since `span (range f) = ⊤`, some `f i` avoids the maximal ideal `m`
159	  obtain ⟨i, hfi⟩ : ∃ i, f i ∉ m := by
160	    by_contra hall
161	    have hle : Ideal.span (Set.range f) ≤ m :=
162	      Ideal.span_le.mpr (Set.range_subset_iff.mpr fun i =>
163	        not_not.mp fun hn => hall ⟨i, hn⟩)
164	    rw [hspan, top_le_iff] at hle
165	    exact hmax.ne_top hle
166	  -- push `I • ⊤ = ⊤` through the (surjective) coordinate projection, enlarge `I` to `m`
167	  have hproj : I • (⊤ : Submodule A (S i)) = ⊤ := by
168	    have hmap := congrArg
169	      (Submodule.map (LinearMap.proj i : (∀ j, S j) →ₗ[A] S i)) hIT
170	    rwa [Submodule.map_smul'', Submodule.map_top,
171	      LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr (LinearMap.proj_surjective i)] at hmap
172	  have hm : m • (⊤ : Submodule A (S i)) = ⊤ := by
173	    have hmono := Submodule.smul_mono_left (N := (⊤ : Submodule A (S i))) hIm
174	    rw [hproj] at hmono
175	    exact top_le_iff.mp hmono
176	  -- the residue-field character `S i →+* A ⧸ m` kills `m • ⊤` but sends `1` to `1`
177	  letI : Field (A ⧸ m) := Ideal.Quotient.field m
178	  have hfm : Ideal.Quotient.mk m (f i) ≠ 0 := fun h0 =>
179	    hfi (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp h0)
180	  have hunit : ∀ y : Submonoid.powers (f i), IsUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk m (y : A)) := by
181	    rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
182	    obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := hy
183	    change IsUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk m (f i ^ n))
184	    rw [map_pow]
185	    exact (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hfm).pow n
186	  have hlift : ∀ x ∈ m • (⊤ : Submodule A (S i)),
187	      IsLocalization.lift (M := Submonoid.powers (f i)) (S := S i) hunit x = 0 := by
188	    intro x hx
189	    refine Submodule.smul_induction_on hx (fun a ha s _ => ?_) (fun u v hu hv => ?_)
190	    · rw [Algebra.smul_def, map_mul, IsLocalization.lift_eq,
191	        Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr ha, zero_mul]
192	    · rw [map_add, hu, hv, add_zero]
193	  have h1 : IsLocalization.lift (M := Submonoid.powers (f i)) (S := S i) hunit (1 : S i) = 0 :=
194	    hlift 1 (by rw [hm]; exact Submodule.mem_top)
195	  rw [map_one] at h1
196	  exact one_ne_zero h1
197	
198	end FaithfullyFlat

206	/-- Tensoring distributes over finite products of algebras, on the right: the `A`-algebra
207	equivalence `N ⊗[A] (∀ i, S i) ≃ₐ[A] ∀ i, N ⊗[A] S i`.  This is
208	`TensorProduct.piRight` upgraded to algebras. -/
209	noncomputable def piRightAlgEquiv : (N ⊗[A] ∀ i, S i) ≃ₐ[A] ∀ i, N ⊗[A] S i :=
210	  -- `map_mul` is checked by two rounds of `TensorProduct.induction_on` (both sides are
211	  -- bilinear); on pure tensors it is componentwise `tmul_mul_tmul`.
212	  AlgEquiv.ofLinearEquiv (_root_.TensorProduct.piRight A A N S)
213	    (by
214	      funext i
215	      simp [Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def])
216	    (fun x y => by
217	      induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
218	      | zero => simp
219	      | add x₁ x₂ h₁ h₂ => simp only [add_mul, map_add, h₁, h₂]
220	      | tmul a s =>
221	        induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on with
222	        | zero => simp
223	        | add y₁ y₂ h₁ h₂ => simp only [mul_add, map_add, h₁, h₂]
224	        | tmul b t =>
225	          funext i
226	          simp [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul])

230	    piRightAlgEquiv A N S (x ⊗ₜ s) = fun i => x ⊗ₜ s i :=
231	  rfl

238	  -- `comm`, then `piRightAlgEquiv`, then componentwise `comm`.

253	  invFun x i j := x (i, j)

255	  right_inv _ := rfl

257	  map_add' _ _ := rfl

291	      have hu : IsUnit (algebraMap A T f) := IsLocalization.Away.isUnit_of_dvd (S := T) g h

295	`Away (f * g)` localization of `A`.  (Mathlib's `IsLocalization.Away.tensor` is the
296	`S`-relative statement; this is the `A`-relative one.)

299	localization of `S` away from `algebraMap A S g`; conclude with
300	`IsLocalization.Away.mul'` along the tower `A → S → S ⊗[A] T`. -/

304	  -- away from `algebraMap A S g`; conclude along the tower `A → S → S ⊗[A] T`.
305	  haveI : IsLocalization.Away (algebraMap A S g) (S ⊗[A] T) :=
306	    IsLocalization.Away.tensor (R := A) (S := S) (A := T) (r := g)
307	  exact IsLocalization.Away.mul' S (S ⊗[A] T) f g

310	`Away g` localization to any `Away (f * g)` localization. -/
311	noncomputable def tensorEquiv' (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [Algebra A C]
312	    [IsLocalization.Away f S] [IsLocalization.Away g T]
313	    [IsLocalization.Away (f * g) C] : (S ⊗[A] T) ≃ₐ[A] C :=
314	  haveI := tensor' f g S T

9	# Descent data from unit 1-cocycles, and the Picard class of a cocycle
10	
11	Let `A → B` be a map of commutative rings.  A **descent 1-cocycle** is a unit
12	`u : (B ⊗[A] B)ˣ` that is normalized along the multiplication `B ⊗[A] B → B` and satisfies
